title: How Does Support Vector Regression (SVR) Differ from Linear Regression?

cues.en: -: Welcome back to your Machine Learning A to Z course.
cues.zh: 歡迎回到 Machine Learning A-Z 課程。

cues.en: Super excited to have you back on board.
cues.zh: 很高興你又回來了。

cues.en: And today we're kicking off the Support Vector Regression Intuition.
cues.zh: 今天要開始建立支援向量迴歸的直覺。

cues.en: Super pumped about these tutorials, got some very exciting slides coming up for you.
cues.zh: 我對這些教學非常期待，也準備了一些很有意思的投影片。

cues.en: So what is Support Vector Regression?
cues.zh: 什麼是支援向量迴歸？

cues.en: Well Support Vector Regression was invented back in the '90s by Vladimir Vapnik and his colleagues who were working at the Bell Labs at the time
cues.zh: 支援向量迴歸是 Vladimir Vapnik 與同事在 1990 年代發展的，他們當時任職於貝爾實驗室，

cues.en: that was the AT&T Bell Labs.
cues.zh: 也就是當時 AT&T 的貝爾實驗室。

cues.en: Now they're Nokia Bell Labs and a lot of Support Vector Machine and Support Vector Regression are discussed in Vladimir Vapnik's book,
cues.zh: 現在則是 Nokia 貝爾實驗室。Vladimir Vapnik 的書中，也討論了許多支援向量機與支援向量迴歸，

cues.en: "The Nature of Statistical Learning, 1992".
cues.zh: 書名是《The Nature of Statistical Learning》，講者這裡說是 1992 年。

cues.en: In this course, we will be covering both Support Vector Machine in the part of the course to do with classification and Support Vector Regression.
cues.zh: 這門課會同時介紹支援向量機，放在分類的部分，以及支援向量迴歸。

cues.en: We'll be talking about it here.
cues.zh: 支援向量迴歸就在這裡介紹。

cues.en: And in addition to that, we'll also be talking about Kernel Support Vector Machine and Kernel Support Vector Regression and the Kernel Trick and many other things like that.
cues.zh: 此外，也會談到核支援向量機、核支援向量迴歸、核技巧，以及許多相關概念。

cues.en: So there's a lot of exciting tutorials on these topics, but for now we're just going to limit ourselves to Support Vector Regression, specifically Linear Support Vector Regression.
cues.zh: 這些主題有許多精彩的教學，不過現在先限於支援向量迴歸，尤其是線性支援向量迴歸。

cues.en: So here we go.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Here we've got two plots and we need that in order to compare SVR to the simple linear regression that'll really help us understand things.
cues.zh: 這裡有兩張圖，用來比較 SVR 和簡單線性迴歸，能幫助我們理解。

cues.en: So here on the left, we've got some random plots, or random dots.
cues.zh: 左邊有一些隨機資料點。

cues.en: I'm gonna copy them over to the right.
cues.zh: 我把它們複製到右邊。

cues.en: So we know that these are identical.
cues.zh: 所以我們知道兩邊完全相同。

cues.en: There's no tricks involved.
cues.zh: 沒有任何花招。

cues.en: This is an absolutely identical set of data.
cues.zh: 這兩份資料完全一樣。

cues.en: And let's start with the one on the left.
cues.zh: 先從左邊開始。

cues.en: We're gonna apply a simple linear regression.
cues.zh: 我們套用簡單線性迴歸。

cues.en: We've already discussed what it's like but let's quickly refresh.
cues.zh: 已經討論過它的做法，現在快速複習。

cues.en: So basically we're gonna have this line go through the data and how's this line derived?
cues.zh: 基本上會有一條直線穿過資料，而這條線怎麼求得呢？

cues.en: Well, a method called the ordinary least squares method will be applied to find this line.
cues.zh: 會使用稱為普通最小平方法的方法，來找出這條線。

cues.en: Basically, we want to minimize the distance between this value, why the actual value in the data and why hat, basically what it would've been
cues.zh: 基本上，希望讓資料中的實際值 y，和預測值 ŷ 之間的差距盡可能小；ŷ 就是

cues.en: on the trendline.
cues.zh: 趨勢線上對應的值。

cues.en: We take the difference here or difference here, we square it and we wanna minimize that.
cues.zh: 取這裡或這裡的差值，平方，再將它最小化。

cues.en: That's ordinary least squares method.
cues.zh: 這就是普通最小平方法。

cues.en: Essentially, what we're doing is minimizing the error.
cues.zh: 本質上，我們在最小化誤差。

cues.en: We want to have a line with the minimum error possible.
cues.zh: 希望找到誤差盡可能小的一條線。

cues.en: So that's the intuition behind a simple linear regression, something we already talked about.
cues.zh: 這就是簡單線性迴歸的直覺，我們之前已經談過。

cues.en: Now, how does the Support Vector Regression work?
cues.zh: 那麼支援向量迴歸如何運作？

cues.en: Well, let's have a look on the right.
cues.zh: 看看右邊。

cues.en: With SVR, instead of a simple line, you'll see a tube.
cues.zh: SVR 不只是一條簡單的線，你會看到一個管狀區域。

cues.en: And here you have the regression line in the middle but then there's this tube around it and what does this tube do?
cues.zh: 中央是迴歸直線，周圍則有這個管狀區域，它有什麼作用呢？

cues.en: Well, this tube has a width of epsilon and the width has measured vertically.
cues.zh: 這個管狀區域的寬度由 epsilon 決定，而且寬度是沿垂直方向測量。

cues.en: It's important along this axis, not perpendicular to the tube but vertically.
cues.zh: 注意，是沿著這個軸的方向，而不是與管狀區域垂直的方向。

cues.en: And this tube itself is called the epsilon-insensitive tube.
cues.zh: 這個區域本身稱為 epsilon 不敏感管。

cues.en: And what does that mean?
cues.zh: 這代表什麼？

cues.en: Well, that means that any points in our data set that fall inside the tube, they won't be, we'll be disregarding the error.
cues.zh: 代表資料集中任何落在管內的點，我們都會忽略它的誤差。

cues.en: So basically this tube, think of it as a a margin of error that we are allowing our model to have and not care about any error inside here.
cues.zh: 可以把這個管狀區域，想成模型允許的一個誤差範圍，在這裡面的誤差都不計較。

cues.en: So any discrepancy between or any like distance between this point over here and the line as in, for instance here, we could see,
cues.zh: 所以這個點與直線之間的任何差異，也就是距離，例如這裡可以看到，

cues.en: let's look at which point is that?
cues.zh: 來看看這是哪一個點？

cues.en: That's one, two, three.
cues.zh: 第一、第二、第三。

cues.en: This third point, you can see the line is even different, right?
cues.zh: 這是第三個點，可以看到連直線都不同，對吧？

cues.en: The results can be different and probably will be different.
cues.zh: 兩種方法的結果可能不同，而且通常確實會不同。

cues.en: So this third point here, there's a distance between the line here and we care about this error here.
cues.zh: 第三個點與這裡的直線有一段距離，左圖的這個誤差是我們會考慮的。

cues.en: We don't care about this error because it falls within this epsilon- insensitive tube.
cues.zh: 但右圖的這個誤差不考慮，因為它落在 epsilon 不敏感管內。

cues.en: So we're disregarding any kind of errors in here.
cues.zh: 所以這裡面的任何誤差，我們都忽略。

cues.en: And that's kind of the key behind Support Vector Regression.
cues.zh: 這就是支援向量迴歸的核心。

cues.en: It gives a little bit of movement or a little bit of buffer to our model.
cues.zh: 它為模型提供一點活動空間，或緩衝。

cues.en: And at the same time we have points that are outside the epsilon-insensitive tube.
cues.zh: 同時也有一些點，落在 epsilon 不敏感管之外。

cues.en: There they are.
cues.zh: 就是這些。

cues.en: And for them we do care about the error.
cues.zh: 對這些點，我們就會在意它們的誤差。

cues.en: And here it will be measured as the distance between the point and the tube itself.
cues.zh: 這裡的誤差，是以資料點到管狀區域本身的距離來測量。

cues.en: So not the trendline, but the tube itself.
cues.zh: 不是到趨勢線，而是到管狀區域本身。

cues.en: These distances have names, they're either xC star, if the point is below the tube, or xC, if the point is above the tube.
cues.zh: 這些距離有名稱：點在管下方時記為 ξ*，點在管上方時記為 ξ。

cues.en: And they're called, so these values xC are called slack variables.
cues.zh: 這些 ξ 的值，稱為鬆弛變數。

cues.en: So it's either xC star, if it's below, xC far star, if it's above.
cues.zh: 所以在下方是 ξ*，在上方則是沒有星號的 ξ。

cues.en: And we do care about the error.
cues.zh: 我們確實會考慮這些誤差。

cues.en: So we care about these distances and the way we care about it, so we're gonna try to avoid formulas.
cues.zh: 我們會考慮這些距離。至於如何考慮，我們盡量避免深入公式。

cues.en: I will give additional reading, something you can look into further down at the end of this tutorial.
cues.zh: 這堂課最後會提供延伸閱讀，讓你進一步研究。

cues.en: But just for completeness sake, here is the formula.
cues.zh: 不過為了完整起見，這裡還是列出公式。

cues.en: So in the case of OLS, it was a simple, ordinary least squared like that.
cues.zh: OLS 的情況是這個簡單的普通最小平方法公式。

cues.en: Here's a bit more complex.
cues.zh: 這裡則稍微複雜。

cues.en: We're not gonna talk about this part over here but what we're focusing on is this.
cues.zh: 我們不討論這一部分，而是把焦點放在這裡。

cues.en: And we can see that we are minimizing, we want these distances, the sum of these distances to be minimal.
cues.zh: 可以看到，我們要最小化，也就是希望這些距離的總和盡可能小。

cues.en: Once again, there'll be additional reading at the end if you'd like to go into it.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，如果想深入，最後有延伸閱讀。

cues.en: But effectively these points, the ones that are outside our tube are dictating what the tube will look like, how the tube will be positioned.
cues.zh: 實際上，就是管外的這些點，決定管狀區域的形狀與位置。

cues.en: So the error within the tube is completely disregarded.
cues.zh: 而管內的誤差完全忽略。

cues.en: We don't care about the error unlike in the ordinary least square.
cues.zh: 不像普通最小平方法，我們不在意這些管內誤差。

cues.en: So we're giving some kind of buffer of flexibility to our tube or in like allowing it to, accounting
cues.zh: 也就是為管狀區域提供一些緩衝與彈性，允許它

cues.en: for some kind of error that we might expect in the data.
cues.zh: 容納資料中可能出現的一些誤差。

cues.en: It's normal sometimes for there to be error but these ones, they are important to us.
cues.zh: 資料偶爾有誤差很正常，但管外這些誤差，對我們就很重要。

cues.en: And also one final thing, why is this a method called Support Vector Regression?
cues.zh: 最後還有一點，為什麼這個方法稱為支援向量迴歸？

cues.en: Well, because effectively, these points, all of these points outside, but any point actually, any point on this plot is a vector, right?
cues.zh: 因為實際上，所有管外的點，甚至圖中的任何一個點，都可以視為向量，對吧？

cues.en: Can be represented as a vector in this two dimensional space or a multidimensional space if you have more features.
cues.zh: 它可以表示成二維空間的向量；如果有更多特徵，就是多維空間的向量。

cues.en: So in this case it can presented by two dimensional victors.
cues.zh: 這裡則可以用二維向量表示。

cues.en: So they are all these points of vectors but the ones that we've highlighted and read, the ones outside the tube, they're the support vectors because they are dictating how this tube is created.
cues.zh: 所以這些點都是向量，但我們標成紅色、位於管外的那些點，就是支援向量，因為它們決定這個管如何建立。

cues.en: So basically they're supporting the structure or formation of this tube.
cues.zh: 也就是說，它們支撐了這個管狀區域的結構與形成方式。

cues.en: And that's why they're called support vectors.
cues.zh: 這就是它們被稱為支援向量的原因。

cues.en: And that's why this is a Support Vector Regression.
cues.zh: 所以這個方法就叫做支援向量迴歸。

cues.en: And so there we go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: That's what it's all about.
cues.zh: 這就是整個概念。

cues.en: That's just important to remember the epsilon-insensitive tube and that Support Vector Regression just cares about the errors of anything that's lying outside this tube.
cues.zh: 只要記得 epsilon 不敏感管，以及支援向量迴歸只在意管外資料所產生的誤差。

cues.en: And to finish off, as promised, here's the additional reading.
cues.zh: 最後，依照約定，這裡提供延伸閱讀。

cues.en: So if you'd like to learn a bit more, have a look at chapter four, Support Vector Regression in a book called "Efficient Learning Machines, Theories, Concepts and Applications for Engineers
cues.zh: 如果想了解更多，可以閱讀《Efficient Learning Machines: Theories, Concepts, and Applications for Engineers

cues.en: and System Design" by Mariette Awad and Rahul Khanna.
cues.zh: and System Designers》的第四章〈Support Vector Regression〉，作者是 Mariette Awad 與 Rahul Khanna。

cues.en: And here's a link here where it's aggregated on this portal for published work.
cues.zh: 這裡有連結，這個出版研究入口網站收錄了它。

cues.en: Something you'll note, that it might be a little bit confusing here.
cues.zh: 你可能會注意到一件有點容易混淆的事。

cues.en: They say these are potential support vectors.
cues.zh: 他們稱這些為潛在的支援向量。

cues.en: They are referring only to the ones close.
cues.zh: 指的只是靠近邊界的那些點。

cues.en: I've had a look at different literature and the literature I prefer is the one that says, in this respect, is the one that says that the support vectors are the ones that are outside
cues.zh: 我看過不同文獻；關於這一點，我比較偏好將管外資料點稱為支援向量的說法，

cues.en: and they are outside basically any point outside the tube is a support vector.
cues.zh: 也就是任何位於管外的資料點，都是支援向量。

cues.en: So that's how we talked, discuss it inside this tutorial.
cues.zh: 所以這堂課採用這樣的方式來討論。

cues.en: But have a look at this different literature, maybe that'll be a good perspective to have a different view.
cues.zh: 不過可以看看這份不同的文獻，從不同角度理解，也許會很有幫助。

cues.en: But overall, the first couple of paragraphs describing the whole problem there, very well written, I liked how they were written, I think can be a valuable addition
cues.zh: 總體而言，前面幾段對整個問題的描述寫得很好，我很喜歡，也認為對於

cues.en: if you're looking for additional reading.
cues.zh: 想進一步閱讀的人而言，是很有價值的補充。

cues.en: So there we go, that's a Support Vector Regression.
cues.zh: 好，這就是支援向量迴歸。

cues.en: Hope you enjoy this tutorial and look forward to seeing you next time.
cues.zh: 希望你喜歡這堂課，期待下次見。

cues.en: Until then, happy analyzing.
cues.zh: 在那之前，分析愉快。
